page.text:
In graph-theoretic terms, the reflexive--transitive closure $R^*$
corresponds to reachability in a directed graph: $x \mathrel{R^*} y$ if
and only if there exists a finite path
$x = v_0 \mathrel{R} v_1 \mathrel{R} \dots \mathrel{R} v_k = y$ of length
$k \ge 0$. Setting $k = 0$ provides reflexivity ($x = y$).
